title: TAI orphan runtime database role recovery
objective: Recover only a safe orphaned tai_runtime role left without the dedicated environment or service, then resume the existing least-privilege standalone TAI deployment and exact postflight.
boundaries: Recovery is allowed only when the dedicated environment, override and running TAI service are absent
Elevated role attributes, memberships, grantees, non-TAI privileges, owned objects or active sessions fail closed
The orphan reset occurs only after the existing mutation guard and rollback snapshots
The recreated role retains the existing exact least-privilege grants and runtime attestation
No public model listener, tenant authority, financial authority or external integration is added
REG.RU only and zero new recurring cost
